design_source: STATE_OBJECT_EVENT_ARCHITECTURE_V0_2.md (designer handover 2026-10-05) + designer implementation order of 2026-10-05
separation: PART A (production C1-B1 rounded-state world) and PART B (Exact Expression V1 unrounded exact-real world) are different world semantics. Code, results and verdicts are never combined. PART A modules never import PART B modules and vice versa (a test enforces it).

part_A.executor: a_reference.c1b1_two_atom.step (the REF executor), unchanged. Position profile FX(96,48), momentum profile FX(96,80), dt = 40.

cases.A2_sym: new_run(FX(96,48), 40, r_i=(-71/20,0,0), p_i=(1,-3,0), r_j=(71/20,0,0), p_j=(-1,3,0), momentum_profile=FX(96,80), validated_only=True); comparison uses the stored raws after the initial rounding.

part_A.origin_construction: trusted origins: new_run from the exact values initial_raw / 2^F with validated_only=False (the reconstruction rule recorded in each origin file); the stored raws must equal initial_raw exactly, otherwise the case is not run (CheckError).
part_A.normal_stop: a PhysicsDomainExceeded / IntegratorDomainExceeded / ExecutorLimitExceeded / ContractViolation raised by the executor before 10000 is the case's normal end: status = exception class name, completed_steps recorded. Not a failure of this gate.
part_A.canonical_record: per step t (t = 0 is the initial state): 'v1|t|species_i|r_i|p_i|species_j|r_j|p_j|J|status' with raws as decimal ints, J = J_cache or 'None'. The stream SHA-256 hashes every record in order; the final record carries the stop status.

modes.WORLD_ONLY: the world keeps only the current Run. No snapshot list. Per step the canonical record goes into a streaming SHA-256; checkpoint records are copied into a fixed-size dict (5 entries).
modes.OBSERVER_HISTORY: identical physics loop; an observer appends (t, atoms raws, J, status) to its own list after every step. The observer only reads immutable tuples; nothing flows from observer data to the Run (a test enforces the direction).
modes.PORT: PhysicalObject / InteractionPort / InteractionEvent layer composed of the canonical primitives (c1b1_two_atom.impulse, _drift, segment_min_R2, relative, profile adds). The port produces one InteractionEvent per force evaluation carrying J once; impulse_i = -J and impulse_j = +J on raws; the event checks that the raw total momentum is unchanged by the event. The event object is dropped after the step; only the J needed by the next first half kick is kept (the canonical J_cache, a recomputable cache, not history).
modes.PAIR: A2_sym only. Current state stored as (S_r = r_i + r_j, D_r = r_j - r_i, S_p = p_i + p_j, D_p = p_j - p_i) raw integers (sum, not half-sum: lossless, no half-grid). Atoms reconstructed as r_i = (S_r - D_r)/2 etc. Stepping uses the canonical primitives and the symmetric shortcut (one displacement rounding, atom i gets the negated raw) ONLY while S_r = 0 and S_p = 0 hold; if they fail -> PAIR_STATE_REFUSED at that step. Range checks of both atoms are kept.

part_A.processes: every run is a fresh python process (subprocess). Timing runs: 3 per (case, mode), sequential, no concurrency, tracemalloc OFF. Memory run: 1 per (case, mode) with tracemalloc ON (its CPU time is not used for cost).
part_A.measurements: wall (perf_counter) and CPU (process_time) of the stepping loop; peak RSS of the process (psutil peak_wset on Windows); RSS at every checkpoint; memory run: tracemalloc current and peak at every checkpoint, deep size of the live world state (Run atoms + J_cache) and of the observer history at every checkpoint. RSS and tracemalloc measure different things and are reported separately.

classification.OBSERVER_ISOLATION: PASS iff for every case all runs of WORLD_ONLY and OBSERVER_HISTORY agree on every checkpoint record, final record, stream SHA-256, status and completed_steps; else FAIL (OBSERVER_ISOLATION_FAIL).
classification.WORLD_LIVE_MEMORY: per case, WORLD_ONLY memory run: FLAT iff max/min of the live world state deep size over the checkpoints <= 1.25 AND tracemalloc current at the last checkpoint minus the previous checkpoint <= 65536 bytes (needs >= 1000 completed steps); GROWS otherwise; UNRESOLVED if a measurement is missing or fewer than 1000 steps completed. Overall: GROWS if any case GROWS, else UNRESOLVED if any case UNRESOLVED, else FLAT.
classification.PORT_MODEL: BIT_IDENTICAL iff every PORT run equals WORLD_ONLY (same items as observer isolation) for every case and every event satisfied impulse_i == -impulse_j and exact raw momentum conservation; else FAIL.
classification.PORT_COST: per case ratio r = median CPU(PORT) / median CPU(WORLD_ONLY): LOWER iff r < 0.90 for every case; WORSE iff r > 1.10 for some case; else TIE. PORT_STRUCTURE_ONLY iff BIT_IDENTICAL and PORT_COST in {TIE, WORSE} and the PORT live state deep size is not lower.
classification.PAIR_CURRENT_STATE: LOSSLESS iff the reconstructed atoms equal the canonical stored atoms at every step (stream SHA-256 and checkpoint records equal WORLD_ONLY) with the symmetric precondition holding throughout; REFUSED iff the precondition fails (PAIR_STATE_REFUSED, step recorded); FAIL iff any reconstructed record differs.
classification.PAIR_COST: ratio median CPU(PAIR)/median CPU(WORLD_ONLY) on A2_sym with the PORT_COST thresholds; state bytes reported next to it.

part_A.not_claimed: no N-body, composite or general memory claim; A2_sym results are not promoted to general pair or N-body statements.

part_B.world: Exact Expression V1 semantics unchanged: exact real state of the UNROUNDED KDK map (dt = 40, h = 20, Ar40 mass of C1-B1, frozen C1-A Lang 2024 force with retardation). FX(96,48)/FX(96,80) projection is measurement only, never fed back.
part_B.baseline: exact_expression_gate_v1.stream.run(q0, p0, prec, last, want, exact=False) imported read-only (C_stream interval). Radii are taken from the baseline's own endpoint text.

candidate.name: EVENT_LINEAGE
candidate.form: every state component is center (one working-precision mpf) + sum over inherited tags of coefficient (one mpf each) * eps_tag + remainder radius (mpf, rounded up). eps_tag in [-1, 1] is a fixed unknown number per tag. Rounding error of every center/coefficient operation is bounded by 2^(1-prec) * |rounded result| and added to the remainder (rounded up). No exact Fraction coefficients.
candidate.tags: created ONLY by InteractionEvents. One event per force evaluation (one per step plus step 0). An event creates up to 3 tags: G (the new error of G(r^2), shared by all components) and one per non-zero impulse component k (all remaining uncertainty of J_k, including inherited remainders and rounding). Atom j receives +J, atom i receives -J with the SAME tag ids (opposite sign). The same event (same J) is used by the second half kick of step s and the first half kick of step s+1, as in the world.
candidate.event_G: r2 form = d.d (form arithmetic). Range [a, b] outward. Domain obligation on [a, b] (V1 rule R >= r_min). s0 = center of r2 (inside [a, b]). G(s0) enclosed by exact_expression_gate_v0.lang_iv.G_of_R2 at the working precision (shared TCB with the baseline). G'([a, b]) = hull of the certificate cells covering [sqrt(a), sqrt(b)]; alpha = midpoint of that hull. G(s) = G(s0) + alpha (s - s0) + e with |e| <= max|G' - alpha| * max|s - s0| (mean value theorem). G form = mid G(s0) + alpha * (tags of r2) + one new G tag with coefficient = rad G(s0) + |e| bound + |alpha| * remainder(r2) + rounding.
candidate.event_J: J_k = 20 * G * d_k (form product); its remainder and the widths are moved into the new tag of component k; J_k then has no remainder.
candidate.no_feedback: centers are working-precision numbers of an enclosure; no midpoint, center or projected cell replaces the state.

derivative_certificate.source: a_reference.c1b1_energy_bound.radial_derivatives(a, b) (existing, unchanged); never called at run time.
derivative_certificate.per_cell: V' and V'' enclosures (exact rationals as returned) and G'(s) = (V'(R) - R V''(R)) / (2 R^3) enclosed by exact interval arithmetic over the cell's R interval.
derivative_certificate.outside: any event whose R range is not inside the certificate -> EVENT_DERIVATIVE_DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED (STOP, no extrapolation).
derivative_certificate.checker: separate module, separate process: protocol hash, generator source hashes, cell coverage without gap or overlap, endpoint ordering, finiteness, domain, recomputation of every cell with radial_derivatives in a fresh process (stored values must equal), independent G' recomputation from the stored V', V'' with its own interval code, and an independent necessary check of V'' per cell: (V'(b) - V'(a)) / (b - a) from c1b1_two_atom._model_R point enclosures must intersect V''(cell), and _model_R's V' at both ends must intersect V'(cell). The generator's PASS flag is never read.

soundness_tests_before_campaign: reusing one id for two events is detected (allocator guard; sampled exact oracle shows the false cancellation)
a forged zero nonlinear remainder is detected by the sampled exact oracle
inward rounding of the remainder is detected by the sampled exact oracle
certificate lookup at a cell boundary uses the hull of both cells
R range outside the certificate -> EVENT_DERIVATIVE_DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED
reading/deciding a checkpoint does not change the state (no projection or midpoint feedback)
part_B.campaign_gate: if any PART B soundness test fails, no PART B campaign is run.
part_B.metrics: per path and checkpoint: FX cell decided?, worst normalized position radius (radius / 2^-48), worst normalized momentum radius (radius / 2^-80), CPU and wall of the pass (median of 3 runs, fresh process each), peak RSS, tag count, max remainder.
part_B.soundness_in_campaign: at every checkpoint the checker replays A2_bound itself at 512 bits (own interval code, shared lang_iv TCB). Candidate and baseline ranges must intersect the reference enclosure for every component; every decided cell must equal the reference cells; tag count <= 3 * (steps + 1).
part_B.extension_rule_fixed: extend to stage 2 = {(96, 1000), (128, 1000)} with checkpoints 10/100/1000 iff (candidate DECIDED at 96-bit step 100 OR baseline worst normalized radius >= 2 x candidate worst normalized radius at 96-bit step 100) AND soundness PASS AND candidate CPU <= 10 x baseline CPU at stage 1. Otherwise stop: EVENT_LINEAGE_NO_SIGNAL (no signal), EVENT_LINEAGE_COST_WALL (CPU > 10x), EVENT_LINEAGE_SOUNDNESS_FAIL (soundness).
part_B.tag_cap_rule: tag count > MAX_TAGS -> the pass stops with LINEAGE_TAG_CAP (REFUSED). Fixed before running.

classification.LINEAGE_SOUNDNESS: PASS iff all soundness tests pass and every in-campaign soundness check passes; FAIL if any fails; UNRESOLVED if a check could not be performed.
classification.LINEAGE_CORRELATION: YES iff at 96-bit step 100 the candidate decides where the baseline does not, or the baseline worst normalized radius >= 2 x the candidate's; NO otherwise; UNRESOLVED if soundness is not PASS.
classification.LINEAGE_COST: ratio = candidate median CPU / baseline median CPU at stage 1: FASTER < 0.8, TIE 0.8..1.25, WORSE 1.25..10, COST_WALL > 10.
classification.TAG_GROWTH: CONTROLLED iff every run stays within 3 * (steps + 1) tags and MAX_TAGS; WALL otherwise.

forbidden: reusing an id for different events

no_post_hoc_changes: cases, checkpoints, modes, thresholds, certificate domain and cell width, extension rule, caps and classifications are fixed before any campaign run.
